titulo: 5 Ways Love Can Be a Trap — Parte 1: Love Bombing

lineas.texto: Someone calls you "soulmate" after three days? That's not love. That's a target on your back.
Here are five signs.
Number one is the one that traps you.
Love bombing is one of five manipulation tactics that hide inside love. Today, we start with the first one.
Number five. Too much, too fast.
"I love you" in week one.
They don't know you. They need you hooked.
And the next sign shows up by day ten.
Number four. A whole future by day ten.
Meet my family. Move in together. I want kids. You've met twice.
That's not romance. It's a script.
The next one lives in your phone.
Number three. Constant contact.
Forty texts a day.
Miss one and it's "why are you ignoring me?"
That's not care. It's a leash with a heart on it.
And the next one will cost you.
Number two. Grand gestures.
Flowers. Trips. Expensive gifts.
Every gift is a small invoice.
Say no, and suddenly you're the ungrateful one.
But number one is the reason behind all of it.
Number one. They isolate you.
"Your friends don't get us."
"You don't need them. You have me."
One by one, your people go quiet.
Then one day you say: "I need space."
And the sun switches off.
Real love doesn't rush you. It waits.
Count your signs.
Three or more? You're not overreacting.
Comment your number.
